messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT EG-1291 — multiple serving nodes in gpu-pool-02 reporting CUDA illegal memory access + container restarts. Auto-page/evict alerts firing. Initiating incident channel.
Sam (oncall): noticed spike ~ 18:02 UTC — 5 nodes flapped within 8m, ~30% of capacity for model-std-16k. 503s and streaming truncation for some requests.
Maya (eng-runtime): attaching logs, looks like `cudaIllegalAddress` in `serve_worker` during KV cache restore after reload. Small repro attached to the thread.
Diego (infra): confirming node telemetry — kernel OOPS traces referencing `mmu_notifier` and `pagewalk`. NV driver 525.85.08, kernel 5.15.0-88.
Sam (oncall): can we cordon the noisy nodes and shift traffic?
Priya (sre): `kubectl cordon gpu-node-22 gpu-node-23 gpu-node-24` in progress. Starting graceful drain on gpu-node-22 (pods: model-serving*).
Anya (cust-success): flagging impacted customers: tenant-neo saw 12% of requests fail or timeout. Sending status note now.
Maya (eng-runtime): quick diagnostic command I ran: ```gdb --batch -ex 'thread apply all bt' -ex 'quit' /opt/serve/bin/worker core.1234``` shows vectorized kernel frame in `attn_kernel.cu` and a divergent pointer: `invalid device address 0x7f8c0000`.
Sam (oncall): stacking a fallback — routing model-std-16k to model-std-8k CPU-compat variant for new traffic (degraded perf but keeps requests alive). Initiating route override.
Diego (infra): driver-level mitigation attempt: restarting nvidia container runtime on affected nodes to clear stale mappings: `systemctl restart nvidia-containerd` on gpu-node-22 done, node rejoined, one Pod restarted and errored again.
Maya (eng-runtime): hypothesis: KV cache restore + prefetch path hits a stale device pointer under high concurrency, race in buffer pin/unpin. Need hotfix in runtime to validate device pointers and fallback to host copy when suspicious.
Priya (sre): for immediate mitigation we should reduce concurrency on serving pods: set env `MAX_CONCURRENCY=8` for model-std-16k rollout to limit overlap. Patch applied to canary.
Sam (oncall): canary with concurrency limit healthy for 10m, no illegal mem observed. Rolling to remaining replicas slowly.
Anya (cust-success): updated tenants: neo, atlas, and polaris notified — telling them we applied degraded-mode fallback and are limiting concurrency; ETA 60m for stabilization.
Maya (eng-runtime): collecting more artifacts: kernel oops logs, full `dmesg`, container runtime logs, `nvidia-smi -q` snapshots. Will open a bug with stacktrace and reproducible harness.
Diego (infra): scheduling maintenance window to repro on a sacrificial node with debug kernels and driver tracing. Won't affect production pool.
Sam (oncall): handing off to Maya for hotfix development and Diego for infra repro. Priya — please keep the channel for escalations, update every 30m.
Priya (sre): acknowledged. Keeping cordon until we confirm no latent flaps.
Maya (eng-runtime): posting initial patch plan: 1) add pointer sanity checks on KV load, 2) add guarded copy path, 3) add a runtime flag to force host-copy fallback for affected model families. Will validate with synthetic load.
Sam (oncall): ops-bot — mark incident as partial customer impact. :warning:
ops-bot: Incident EG-1291 status: partial impact; mitigation: traffic reroute + concurrency cap. Customers notified.
Anya (cust-success): sending targeted follow-up to tenant-neo about request-level logs and offer to replay failed calls for debugging.
Maya (eng-runtime): ETA for patch and canary rollout: ~2.5 hours. Will push to canary infra first, then expand if green.
Diego (infra): repro job scheduled for 45m from now with tracing enabled (ftrace + driver logs). Will attach artifact link once available.
Sam (oncall): leaving brief summary for post-incident: root cause likely race in KV cache restore leading to invalid device pointer use under concurrent reloads; immediate mitigations: cordon noisy nodes, reduce concurrency, route to CPU-compat variant for new requests, restart container runtime where helpful. Next steps: runtime hotfix + infra repro + kernel/driver trace.
Priya (sre): handoff complete — Maya owning engineering fix, Diego owning repro infra, Sam remains primary oncall until next shift, Anya owning customer comms. I'll update status page and incident ticket.
Maya (eng-runtime): will post PR link and canary results here when ready.
Sam (oncall): thanks all.
ops-bot: INCIDENT EG-1291 — channel archived for read-only after stabilization.
